target.title: feat(ui): live agent activity subtitles on running sidebar sessions
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Running sessions in the sidebar show no hint of what the agent is actually doing — you open each one to find out. The model constantly narrates its work ("Rebasing onto main and rerunning the sidebar suite."), but that stream never reaches the sidebar.

## Why This Change Was Made

Maintainer-requested (part of the sidebar program with #111035): while a session runs, its row shows a live activity subtitle derived from the model's newest narration, web-side only (no gateway changes), behind a synced preference defaulting to on.

## User Impact

- Rows with an active run show the model's latest sentence as a subtitle (markdown stripped, ≤120 chars, subtle crossfade, updates throttled to 2s); when the newest signal is a tool call, the subtitle falls back to the real tool name ("Using exec"). Resting rows stay title-only; run end removes the line.
- Priority: automatic attention (question/approval/error from #111035) always outranks narration; narration outranks the worktree subtitle. Catalog display-object subtitle semantics preserved.
- Purely client-side: the sidebar opens `sessions.messages.subscribe` for up to 6 running rows (newest first; the open chat session's subscription is never touched since the per-connection subscription set is shared, not refcounted), unsubscribes on run end/row removal/disconnect, and resubscribes after reconnect.
- Privacy hardening (driven by nine autoreview rounds): internal-runtime context blocks are suppressed fragment-aware including truncated/nested/partial-delimiter cases; heartbeat/control-reply tokens never render; a mid-run join stays silent until a cumulative snapshot aligns the stream (a bare first delta could be the inside of an internal block); empty or suppressed-only replacements retract the shown line, including anything still queued behind the throttle.
- Performance: append detection is length arithmetic on the cumulative stream (O(delta) per event, resets are O(snapshot) and rare) — long background responses can't go quadratic across six subscriptions.
- Preference "Show live agent activity in sidebar" (default on, only the off-override persists) in Settings, synced via ui.prefs; off = no subscriptions, no rendering.

![narration subtitle](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/main/sidebar-narration/narration-a.png)

- Startup-JS budget: the narration controller (with its token-suppression imports) is a **lazy chunk** loaded on first enabled sync; only the thin element/preference wiring (~1.5 KiB gzip) stays in startup. That exhausted the ratcheted 310 KiB budget's headroom, so this PR raises it to **312 KiB** with an inline justification in scripts/check-control-ui-performance.mjs (same pattern as the maintainer-approved CSS bump) — flagging explicitly for review.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/components/app-sidebar.test.ts ui/src/components/app-sidebar-session-narration.test.ts` — 158 pass post-rebase (subscription lifecycle incl. cap eviction/agent rebind/source swap; derivation incl. markdown/sentence/throttle; privacy cases: internal blocks truncated+nested, heartbeat-mixed, mid-run-join silence, empty/suppressed replacement retraction; attention-over-narration precedence; pref off inert). session-row-subtitle + settings/server-prefs/config-view suites pass.
- Mock-gateway harness test (6 pass) proves the `sessions.messages.subscribe` contract end-to-end, including a repeating narration demo fixture (subscribe → assistant line → tool line → second cycle → unsubscribe stops events).
- Live-verified in the mock dev harness: running row shows "Rebasing onto main and rerunnin…" then "Using exec" (DOM-inspected; screenshot above shows narration coexisting with the attention states).
- Codex autoreview (gpt-5.6-sol), nine rounds to convergence; final round clean. Chat payload shapes were verified against the real consumer (chat-state) and server broadcast scoping (SESSION_SUBSCRIPTION_EVENTS), not guessed.
